citation: Brysbaert, M., & New, B. (2009). Behavior Research Methods, 41, 977-990. doi:10.3758/BRM.41.4.977

normalization.split_entry_policy: Each token occurrence receives the full entry FREQcount
normalization.duplicate_policy: Sum all normalized token occurrences across source rows
normalization.probability_denominator: Sum of transformed token counts; not original corpus size
normalization.oov_policy: Absent words have probability zero; smoothing belongs to the downstream mixture
